answer:
Sarkari Seva Overview & Guidance 2026

e-Tender Registration & Digital Signature (CPP Portal) ke liye official single-window portal foscos.fssai.gov.in par visit kare. Business details, PAN, Aadhaar, Bank details aur PAN card upload kare. Mandatory inspection ya desk verification ke baad e-Certificate generate hota hai jise aap portal se digitally sign karke download kar sakte hain. Source: foscos.fssai.gov.in

Aavedan Prakriya - Step by Step Process

  • Official portal https://foscos.fssai.gov.in par visit kare.
  • Apna Mobile Number aur OTP dalkar authentication complete kare.
  • Form me zaroori jankari jaise Name, Address, Aadhaar Details, Bank Passbook bhare.
  • Scanned copies of required documents upload kare aur eKYC verify kare.
  • NetBanking / UPI / SBI ePay se prescribe fees pay kare aur acknowledgement slip save kare.

Zaroori Documents List (Required Proofs)

  • Aadhaar Card (Mobile Number Linked)
  • Voter ID Card / Domicile Certificate / Address Proof
  • Income Certificate & Bank Passbook Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Helpline & Official Source

Kuch bhi samasya hone par official portal https://foscos.fssai.gov.in par Grievance section check kare ya Toll-Free Number 1800-11-0001 par call kare. Source: https://foscos.fssai.gov.in
